evidence_source: contributor-reported; one hardware run on the internal-ESP route

hardware.display: all monitors on the RTX; AMI aggregate console (same topology as B660M_3070TI)

route: internal dedicated ESP (GU_INTERNAL_BOOT); firmware bootsequence one-shot then first in displayorder

efi.reproducible: research/headless/build-unlock.ps1 -HardwareProfile b660m-3090ti rebuilds child and wrapper; the wrapper embeds the builder's Windows ESP GUID so its hash differs on other machines

derivation.machine_fingerprints: console text-out, graphics console, combo, EDID and nvgop drivers byte-identical to the B660M_3070TI profile
derivation.gpu_constants: board 10de:2203, subsystem 1301:7377, chip 0xb72000a1, memory 0x5ff4 MiB, BAR0 0x82000000-0x82ffffff, PROM sha256 22b77e84..., FRTS 0x5ff200000

probe.note: one cold boot of the read-only generic internal-ESP probe (DIAG03.TXT); the constants matched the sibling-reviewed B660M_3070TI machine fingerprints and the GA102 layout exactly
